issues.t: Ignition key can slip out of Run
issues.sym: The engine shuts off while driving, often after the key or keychain gets bumped; steering and brakes get heavy and the airbags may not deploy.
issues.why: A heavy key ring or a knee bump can turn the ignition out of Run. These cars were part of GM's large ignition key recall.
issues.next: Check the VIN for open recalls and get the free key fix. Until then, drive with only the bare key and nothing hanging from it.

issues.t: Timing chain stretch on the V6
issues.sym: Check engine light with camshaft timing codes, rough running, misfires, or a rattle at startup.
issues.why: The timing chains on these GM V6 engines wear and stretch early, made worse by long oil change intervals and low oil, which throws off the cam timing. GM gave extended coverage on some 2007-2009 cars.
issues.next: Have the codes read and ask a dealer whether your VIN falls under the timing chain special coverage. Change oil more often, keep it topped up, and fix a timing code before the chain fails.

issues.t: Steering shaft bolt may be loose
issues.sym: A clunk or looseness felt through the steering wheel, or steering that does not respond normally.
issues.why: The bolt joining the intermediate steering shaft may not have been tightened at the factory, so the shaft could come apart.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. If the steering feels loose or clunks, stop driving and have the car towed in.

issues.t: Front brake hose fittings corrode and burst
issues.sym: Brake fluid near a front wheel, a low brake fluid warning, or a brake pedal that suddenly sinks.
issues.why: Road salt can corrode the fitting on the front brake hoses until a hose ruptures and brake fluid is lost. This was recalled for cars in salt-belt states.
issues.next: Check the VIN for the brake hose recall. If the pedal goes soft or the brake light comes on, stop driving and have it towed.

issues.t: Front lower control arm can separate
issues.sym: Clunking from the front suspension or a front wheel that suddenly sits at an odd angle.
issues.why: The wrong washer material was used on the lower control arm ball studs, so the arm could work loose from the steering knuckle.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. Stop driving and have it towed if the front end suddenly clunks or the steering pulls hard.

issues.t: Airbags may deploy when the ignition is turned on
issues.sym: Front airbags firing as the key is turned, usually with no crash and the car parked.
issues.why: An interaction with the airbag sensing module could send a false deploy signal at key-on.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this airbag recall and have it done before driving the car regularly.

issues.t: Rear axle pinion seal leak
issues.sym: Gear oil on the rear differential or the driveway, or whining and grinding from the rear.
issues.why: The seal where the driveshaft enters the rear differential can leak. Once the oil is gone, the differential can seize and lock the rear wheels. This was recalled.
issues.next: Check for open recalls and have the axle inspected. Do not keep driving with a whine from the rear axle.

issues.t: V6 can lose fuel supply and stall
issues.sym: The engine stalls with no warning and may not restart.
issues.why: A fault in the fuel supply on V6 models could cut fuel to the engine without any warning light first.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it done promptly; a stall at speed is dangerous.

issues.t: CTS-V fuel pump connector can overheat and leak
issues.sym: Fuel smell, especially near the rear seat or trunk, or a hot electrical smell.
issues.why: The electrical terminals on the fuel pump module can overheat and damage the module, which can let fuel leak and create a fire risk.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. If you smell fuel, park the car and have it inspected before driving again.

issues.t: Passenger airbag sensor mat can fail
issues.sym: The passenger airbag OFF light stays on with an adult in the seat, or the airbag warning light comes on.
issues.why: The sensor mat in the passenger seat that detects an occupant can break, which turns the passenger airbag off.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have it fixed soon. Until then, seat children in the back.

issues.t: Heated washer fluid module can catch fire
issues.sym: Smoke or a burning smell from under the hood, or washers that stop spraying warm fluid.
issues.why: The heated windshield washer module could overheat and start a fire. The recall fix was to disconnect and remove the module.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have the module removed. Stop and shut off the car if you see smoke.

issues.t: Passenger airbag on/off logic error
issues.sym: The passenger airbag status light shows the wrong state for who is sitting there.
issues.why: A software fault could turn the passenger airbag on when it should be off, or off when it should be on.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have the software update done.

issues.t: Rear toe link nuts can loosen
issues.sym: The car wanders, feels loose in the rear, or pulls during lane changes; rear tires may wear unevenly.
issues.why: Wax residue on the rear toe link jam nuts could let them back off, changing rear wheel alignment and handling.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. If the rear feels loose, slow down and have the suspension checked right away.

issues.t: Roof-rail airbags may deploy from driveshaft vibration
issues.sym: The side curtain airbags fire with no crash, often after a strong vibration from under the car.
issues.why: Vibration from the driveshaft could be read by the airbag system as an impact and set off the roof-rail airbags.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and get it done promptly. Have any driveline vibration fixed.

issues.t: Brake booster pushrod nut can loosen
issues.sym: A brake pedal that feels loose or travels farther than normal, or weak braking.
issues.why: The nut on the brake booster pushrod may not have been tightened enough, so it can back off and disconnect the pedal from the brakes.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. If the pedal feels different, stop driving and have it towed.

issues.t: Chassis control module short can stall the car
issues.sym: The engine shuts off while driving, sometimes with warning messages on the dash.
issues.why: The chassis electronic control module could short internally and shut the car down.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have it done promptly; stalling in traffic is dangerous.

issues.t: Shift cable can detach (car may roll away)
issues.sym: The shifter moves but the transmission does not follow, or the car rolls after being put in Park.
issues.why: The shift cable could come off its bracket, so the shifter position no longer matches the gear the transmission is in.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake and check the VIN for this recall. Get it fixed before relying on Park.

issues.t: Front seat weld may be incomplete
issues.sym: Usually nothing; a seat may feel loose or creak on its mount.
issues.why: An incomplete weld in the seat frame could let a front seat come loose under heavy force, such as in a crash.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have the seats inspected promptly.

issues.t: Seat heater can overheat during remote start
issues.sym: Burning smell, smoke, or scorch marks on a seat, especially after using remote start.
issues.why: A damaged seat heater pad can overheat when the heater turns on through remote start, and it can start a fire.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall. Avoid remote start with seat heat until it is fixed, and stop using the car if you smell burning.

issues.t: Brake pedal bracket can break
issues.sym: The brake pedal suddenly goes to the floor or does nothing.
issues.why: The bracket linking the brake pedal to its pushrod could crack and break, cutting the pedal off from the brakes.
issues.next: Check the VIN for this recall and have it done before regular driving.

issues.t: Electric power steering assist can cut out
issues.sym: Steering suddenly becomes heavy, usually with a power steering warning on the dash.
issues.why: The electric power steering can lose its assist, leaving the driver with much harder steering. GM recalled these years more than once.
issues.next: Check the VIN for both steering recalls. If the steering warning appears, slow down and drive only as far as needed to get it repaired.

issues.t: CUE touchscreen freezes or delaminates
issues.sym: The screen looks bubbled or cracked, ignores touches, freezes in hot weather, or responds on its own.
issues.why: The touch layer of the CUE screen can separate from the display with heat and age, and its software can freeze up.
issues.next: A replacement touch panel or software update usually fixes it. Use steering wheel or voice controls in the meantime.
